root_turn.title: Full-runtime evidence acquisition pair and runtime screening harness

objective: Persist the exact approved VS01-T08 design and activation; implement four strict full-runtime pair contracts, a deterministic translations-only initial subject projection, a narrow audited seven-call evidence-acquisition broker over the published T04 packet, a model-free deterministic runtime reference subject, fixed/runtime paired scoring, immutable run and result identities, receipt-last temporary-store behavior, and one benchmark CLI entry point. Validate the real T04/T05/T06/T07 authorities read-only and compile all real T08 authority without executing the real runtime pair, publishing a result, mutating PostgreSQL, or invoking a model, OCR, VLM, network, cloud, or later task.
activated_user_visible_capability: The repository contains a project-owned deterministic full-runtime B08 pair harness and CLI that can later be separately authorized to compare translations-only abstention with audited acquisition and continuation. This implementation turn compiles and validates the real authority but executes zero real T08 pair runs and publishes no T08 result.

required_tests: Validate every supplied design, case, specification, manifest, checksum, package, activation, and sidecar hash before repository mutation.
Recompute the runtime-case and pair-specification identities using RFC 8785 and require the exact frozen values.
Verify VS01-B08-C01 and BENCH-VS01-BATCH-01 remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Verify the runtime prompt is byte-identical to the fixed B08 prompt.
Verify the published T07 result and receipt bind the fixed B08 case at 8/8 and exact case identity.
Generate the translations-only subject projection twice and require byte-identical output with exactly two initial evidence records and no hidden fields.
Generate the deterministic reference-runtime fixture twice and require byte-identical output with exact 7/12/15/10/7/15/17 counts.
Require the subject package to omit expected tool order, expected outputs, scorer data, T04/T05 answer content, archive/database coordinates, and hidden evidence.
Require the broker to reject unknown tools, missing fields, extra fields, duplicate calls, reordered calls, exhausted budgets, retry attempts, and wrong source handles.
Require no answer candidate before EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_REASSESSED.
Require exactly one T04 packet load and zero raw-source, T03, network, model, OCR, and VLM reads.
Require the exact SBLGNT text and MorphGNT parse from the approved T04 authority.
Require the exact Abbott-Smith sense structure and target-passage locator without contextual overclaim.
Require the final evidence ledger to contain exactly twelve records and the answer claim ledger exactly fifteen records.
Require all ten citations, seven Study blocks, three alternatives, and two material UNKNOWN claims to match T05 authority.
Require fixed/runtime pair arithmetic 3 fixed criteria, 8 runtime criteria, 11 total criteria, weight sum 18, and maximum 36 points.
Require reference conformance to equal fixed 8/8, runtime 28/28, pair 36/36, 7/7 calls, 17/17 events, and zero hard failures or leakage incidents.
Evaluate every hard failure with actual mutated synthetic tool, evidence, claim, answer, event, and correction records; never inject an out-of-band failure answer key.
Test that fixed evidence abstains when tools are unavailable and the runtime acquires and continues when tools are available.
Test correction before and after answer creation without overwriting the earlier immutable run.
Run two complete synthetic deterministic replays and require equal semantic run, pair-result, ledger, answer, and event-chain identities.

Test receipt-last publication, verified-existing behavior, exact partial recovery, symlink and ancestor rejection, complete writes, immutable modes, and unrelated incoming preservation in temporary archives only.

Require public contracts and generated Draft 2020-12 schemas to reject recomputed outer identities when tool order, evidence, claims, scores, thresholds, upstream authority, counts, dispositions, or publication bindings change.
Require the CLI to expose only deterministic-runtime for the T08 pair and return stable redacted machine-readable errors.
Require schema generation, registry hashes, names, versions, ownership, and order to remain exact.
Require the full local suite, branch-aware coverage at least 90%, Ruff, Pyright, schema drift, registry, Git diff, and integrity checks to pass.
Require exact-head vs01-t01-ci and vs01-t05-ci to pass.
